claims.statement: Management states an internal benchmark to grow the store base by around 15% annually.
claims.quote: internally, our benchmarks will remain that we should be opening around 15% of our store base as the number that we want to increase annually.
claims.speaker: management

facts.statement: At the end of March 2026, the company had about 20.6 million square feet of retail business area.
facts.quote: At the end of March 2026, we had about 20.6 million square feet of retail business area

facts.statement: The company reported a turnover of close to INR67,000 crores in the previous year.
facts.quote: We reported a turnover of close to INR67,000 crores in the year gone by.

facts.statement: As of March 2026, the company had 68 lease stores.
facts.quote: last year, for example, we now have about 68 stores -- 65 stores which are on long leases.

facts.statement: Total net borrowing on the company was close to INR965 crores as of March 2026 end.
facts.quote: The actual debt, which is net borrowing on the company, is close to INR965 crores as of March 2026 end.
